title: Discounts on Certificate Renewals Booked by Support
content:
**Reseller desk pricing note: SSL/TLS Certificates.** This note covers the discount on a support renewal of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription, meaning a one-year renewal that Harborline support books for the customer during a conversation. The discount reduces the support renewal amount. It follows two schedules.

**Schedule 1: the account tier.** This schedule reads the tier recorded on the customer's account in Harborline Customer Accounts.

- A Harborline Reseller Platinum, Harborline Reseller Gold, Harborline Reseller Silver or Harborline Reseller Bronze account has a tier percentage. It is the SSL certificate discount percentage that the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for that tier.
- An account on any other tier has no tier percentage.

**Schedule 2: the early-renewal promotion.** The promotion is 15 percent. It applies to a support renewal booked more than 30 days before the subscription end date. It covers the certificate price only and never the extra names.

## How the two schedules combine

Following the account charter, the two schedules apply price component by price component. The two components are the product's 1-year price and the extra names, each extra name at the product's price per added name per year.

| Tier percentage | Booked more than 30 days before the end date | 1-year price | Extra names |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | reduced by the single higher of the tier percentage and 15 percent; the two are never added | reduced by the tier percentage alone |
| yes | no | reduced by the tier percentage | reduced by the tier percentage |
| no | yes | reduced by 15 percent | not reduced |
| no | no | not reduced | not reduced |

The reduced amount is rounded half up to the cent.

## The 30-day boundary

The days are calendar days from the day the renewal is booked to the subscription end date. Hypothetical case: the subscription ends on 14 March 2033.

- Booked on 11 February 2033: 31 days remain. That is more than 30, so the promotion applies.
- Booked on 12 February 2033: exactly 30 days remain. That is not more than 30, so the promotion does not apply.

## Hypothetical worked figures

These figures are illustrative only and are not product prices. Assume a 1-year price of USD 80.00, 7 extra names at USD 11.00 each (USD 77.00 together) and a tier percentage of 12 percent.

- **Both schedules apply.** The 1-year price takes the higher of 12 and 15 percent, which is 15 percent: USD 68.00. The names take 12 percent: USD 67.76. The reduced amount is USD 135.76.
- **Tier percentage only.** The whole USD 157.00 is reduced by 12 percent. The reduced amount is USD 138.16.
- **Promotion only.** The 1-year price becomes USD 68.00 and the names stay at USD 77.00. The reduced amount is USD 145.00.
- **Neither schedule applies.** The reduced amount is USD 157.00.
